# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Data Plane API Reference

> Welcome to the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Data Plane API reference. Data Plane actions process and handle data or workloads within AWS services.

- [Welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/Welcome.md)
- [Common Parameters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/CommonParameters.md)
- [Common Error Types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/CommonErrors.md)

## [Actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Operations.md)

- [BatchCreateMemoryRecords](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BatchCreateMemoryRecords.md): Creates multiple memory records in a single batch operation for the specified memory with custom content.
- [BatchDeleteMemoryRecords](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BatchDeleteMemoryRecords.md): Deletes multiple memory records in a single batch operation from the specified memory.
- [BatchUpdateMemoryRecords](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BatchUpdateMemoryRecords.md): Updates multiple memory records with custom content in a single batch operation within the specified memory.
- [CompleteResourceTokenAuth](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CompleteResourceTokenAuth.md): Confirms the user authentication session for obtaining OAuth2.0 tokens for a resource.
- [CreateABTest](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CreateABTest.md): Creates an A/B test for comparing agent configurations.
- [CreateEvent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CreateEvent.md): Creates an event in an AgentCore Memory resource.
- [CreatePaymentInstrument](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CreatePaymentInstrument.md): Create a new payment instrument for a connector.
- [CreatePaymentSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CreatePaymentSession.md): Create a new payment session.
- [DeleteABTest](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteABTest.md): Deletes an A/B test and its associated gateway rules.
- [DeleteBatchEvaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteBatchEvaluation.md): Deletes a batch evaluation and its associated results.
- [DeleteEvent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteEvent.md): Deletes an event from an AgentCore Memory resource.
- [DeleteMemoryRecord](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteMemoryRecord.md): Deletes a memory record from an AgentCore Memory resource.
- [DeletePaymentInstrument](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_DeletePaymentInstrument.md): Deletes a payment instrument.
- [DeletePaymentSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_DeletePaymentSession.md): Deletes a payment session.
- [DeleteRecommendation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteRecommendation.md): Deletes a recommendation and its associated results.
- [Evaluate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Evaluate.md): Performs on-demand evaluation of agent traces using a specified evaluator.
- [GetABTest](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetABTest.md): Retrieves detailed information about an A/B test, including its configuration, status, and statistical results.
- [GetAgentCard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetAgentCard.md): Retrieves the A2A agent card associated with an AgentCore Runtime agent.
- [GetBatchEvaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetBatchEvaluation.md): Retrieves detailed information about a batch evaluation, including its status, configuration, results, and any error details.
- [GetBrowserSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetBrowserSession.md): Retrieves detailed information about a specific browser session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [GetCodeInterpreterSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetCodeInterpreterSession.md): Retrieves detailed information about a specific code interpreter session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [GetEvent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetEvent.md): Retrieves information about a specific event in an AgentCore Memory resource.
- [GetMemoryRecord](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetMemoryRecord.md): Retrieves a specific memory record from an AgentCore Memory resource.
- [GetPaymentInstrument](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetPaymentInstrument.md): Get a payment instrument by ID.
- [GetPaymentInstrumentBalance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetPaymentInstrumentBalance.md): Get the balance of a payment instrument.
- [GetPaymentSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetPaymentSession.md): Get a payment session.
- [GetRecommendation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetRecommendation.md): Retrieves detailed information about a recommendation, including its configuration, status, and results.
- [GetResourceApiKey](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetResourceApiKey.md): Retrieves the API key associated with an API key credential provider.
- [GetResourceOauth2Token](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetResourceOauth2Token.md): Returns the OAuth 2.0 token of the provided resource.
- [GetResourcePaymentToken](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetResourcePaymentToken.md): Generates authentication tokens for payment providers that use vendor-specific authentication mechanisms.
- [GetWorkloadAccessToken](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetWorkloadAccessToken.md): Obtains a workload access token for agentic workloads not acting on behalf of a user.
- [GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT.md): Obtains a workload access token for agentic workloads acting on behalf of a user, using a JWT token.
- [GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId.md): Obtains a workload access token for agentic workloads acting on behalf of a user, using the user's ID.
- [InvokeAgentRuntime](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_InvokeAgentRuntime.md): Sends a request to an agent or tool hosted in an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime and receives responses in real-time.
- [InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand.md): Executes a command in a runtime session container and streams the output back to the caller.
- [InvokeBrowser](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_InvokeBrowser.md): Invokes an operating system-level action on a browser session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [InvokeCodeInterpreter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_InvokeCodeInterpreter.md): Executes code within an active code interpreter session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [InvokeHarness](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_InvokeHarness.md): Operation to invoke a Harness.
- [ListABTests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListABTests.md): Lists all A/B tests in the account.
- [ListActors](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListActors.md): Lists all actors in an AgentCore Memory resource.
- [ListBatchEvaluations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListBatchEvaluations.md): Lists all batch evaluations in the account, providing summary information about each evaluation's status and configuration.
- [ListBrowserSessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListBrowserSessions.md): Retrieves a list of browser sessions in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that match the specified criteria.
- [ListCodeInterpreterSessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListCodeInterpreterSessions.md): Retrieves a list of code interpreter sessions in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that match the specified criteria.
- [ListEvents](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListEvents.md): Lists events in an AgentCore Memory resource based on specified criteria.
- [ListMemoryExtractionJobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListMemoryExtractionJobs.md): Lists all long-term memory extraction jobs that are eligible to be started with optional filtering.
- [ListMemoryRecords](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListMemoryRecords.md): Lists memory records in an AgentCore Memory resource based on specified criteria.
- [ListPaymentInstruments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListPaymentInstruments.md): List payment instruments for a manager.
- [ListPaymentSessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListPaymentSessions.md): List payment sessions.
- [ListRecommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListRecommendations.md): Lists all recommendations in the account, with optional filtering by status.
- [ListSessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ListSessions.md): Lists sessions in an AgentCore Memory resource based on specified criteria.
- [ProcessPayment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ProcessPayment.md): Processes a payment using a payment instrument within a payment session.
- [RetrieveMemoryRecords](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_RetrieveMemoryRecords.md): Searches for and retrieves memory records from an AgentCore Memory resource based on specified search criteria.
- [SaveBrowserSessionProfile](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_SaveBrowserSessionProfile.md): Saves the current state of a browser session as a reusable profile in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [SearchRegistryRecords](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_SearchRegistryRecords.md): Searches for registry records using semantic, lexical, or hybrid queries.
- [StartBatchEvaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_StartBatchEvaluation.md): Starts a batch evaluation job that evaluates agent performance across multiple sessions.
- [StartBrowserSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_StartBrowserSession.md): Creates and initializes a browser session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [StartCodeInterpreterSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_StartCodeInterpreterSession.md): Creates and initializes a code interpreter session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [StartMemoryExtractionJob](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_StartMemoryExtractionJob.md): Starts a memory extraction job that processes events that failed extraction previously in an AgentCore Memory resource and produces structured memory records.
- [StartRecommendation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_StartRecommendation.md): Starts a recommendation job that analyzes agent traces and generates optimization suggestions for system prompts or tool descriptions to improve agent performance.
- [StopBatchEvaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_StopBatchEvaluation.md): Stops a running batch evaluation.
- [StopBrowserSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_StopBrowserSession.md): Terminates an active browser session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [StopCodeInterpreterSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_StopCodeInterpreterSession.md): Terminates an active code interpreter session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [StopRuntimeSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_StopRuntimeSession.md): Stops a session that is running in an running AgentCore Runtime agent.
- [UpdateABTest](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateABTest.md): Updates an A/B test's configuration, including variants, traffic allocation, evaluation settings, or execution status.
- [UpdateBrowserStream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateBrowserStream.md): Updates a browser stream.


## [Data Types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Types.md)

- [A2aDescriptor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_A2aDescriptor.md): The A2A (Agent-to-Agent) descriptor configuration for a registry record.
- [ABTestEvaluationConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ABTestEvaluationConfig.md): The evaluation configuration for an A/B test, specifying which online evaluation configurations to use for measuring variant performance.
- [ABTestResults](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ABTestResults.md): The statistical results of an A/B test.
- [ABTestSummary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ABTestSummary.md): Summary information about an A/B test.
- [ActorSummary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ActorSummary.md): Contains summary information about an actor in an AgentCore Memory resource.
- [AffectedSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_AffectedSession.md): A session affected by a detected failure pattern, including root cause details.
- [AgentCardDefinition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_AgentCardDefinition.md): The agent card definition for A2A descriptors, including the schema version and inline content that describes the agent's capabilities.
- [AgentSkillsDescriptor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_AgentSkillsDescriptor.md): The agent skills descriptor configuration for a registry record.
- [AgentTracesConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_AgentTracesConfig.md): The configuration specifying where to read agent traces from for recommendation analysis.
- [Amount](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Amount.md): Represents a monetary amount with a currency.
- [AutomationStream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_AutomationStream.md): The configuration for a stream that enables programmatic control of a browser session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [AutomationStreamUpdate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_AutomationStreamUpdate.md): Contains information about an update to an automation stream.
- [AvailableLimits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_AvailableLimits.md): The available spending limits for a payment session.
- [BasicAuth](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BasicAuth.md): Configuration for HTTP Basic Authentication using credentials stored in AWS Secrets Manager.
- [BatchEvaluationSummary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BatchEvaluationSummary.md): Summary representation for list responses.
- [BatchEvaluationTraceConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BatchEvaluationTraceConfig.md): Configuration for using a batch evaluation as the source of agent traces for recommendations.
- [Branch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Branch.md): Contains information about a branch in an AgentCore Memory resource.
- [BranchFilter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BranchFilter.md): Contains filter criteria for branches when listing events.
- [BrowserAction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BrowserAction.md): The browser action to perform.
- [BrowserActionResult](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BrowserActionResult.md): The result of a browser action execution.
- [BrowserEnterprisePolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BrowserEnterprisePolicy.md): Browser enterprise policy configuration.
- [BrowserExtension](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BrowserExtension.md): Browser extension configuration.
- [BrowserProfileConfiguration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BrowserProfileConfiguration.md): The configuration for a browser profile in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [BrowserSessionStream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BrowserSessionStream.md): The collection of streams associated with a browser session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [BrowserSessionSummary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_BrowserSessionSummary.md): A condensed representation of a browser session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [Certificate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Certificate.md): A certificate to install in the browser or code interpreter session.
- [CertificateLocation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CertificateLocation.md): The location from which to retrieve a certificate.
- [CloudWatchFilterConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CloudWatchFilterConfig.md): Filter configuration for narrowing down CloudWatch Logs sessions for evaluation.
- [CloudWatchLogsFilter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CloudWatchLogsFilter.md): A filter for narrowing down agent traces from CloudWatch Logs based on key-value comparisons.
- [CloudWatchLogsRule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CloudWatchLogsRule.md): A rule configuration for filtering agent traces from CloudWatch Logs.
- [CloudWatchLogsSource](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CloudWatchLogsSource.md): The configuration for reading agent traces from CloudWatch Logs.
- [CloudWatchLogsTraceConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CloudWatchLogsTraceConfig.md): Configuration for reading agent traces from CloudWatch Logs for recommendation analysis.
- [CloudWatchOutputConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CloudWatchOutputConfig.md): CloudWatch Logs destination for batch evaluation results.
- [CodeInterpreterResult](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CodeInterpreterResult.md): The output produced by executing code in a code interpreter session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [CodeInterpreterSessionSummary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CodeInterpreterSessionSummary.md): A condensed representation of a code interpreter session in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
- [CodeInterpreterStreamOutput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CodeInterpreterStreamOutput.md): Contains output from a code interpreter stream.
- [CoinbaseCdpTokenRequestInput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CoinbaseCdpTokenRequestInput.md): Coinbase CDP token request parameters.
- [CoinbaseCdpTokenResponseOutput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CoinbaseCdpTokenResponseOutput.md): Coinbase CDP token response.
- [ConfidenceInterval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ConfidenceInterval.md): A confidence interval for a statistical measurement.
- [ConfigurationBundleRef](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ConfigurationBundleRef.md): A reference to a specific version of a configuration bundle.
- [ConfigurationBundleToolEntry](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ConfigurationBundleToolEntry.md): Maps a tool name to its JSON path within a configuration bundle.
- [Content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Content.md): Contains the content of a memory item.
- [ContentBlock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ContentBlock.md): A block of content in a response.
- [ContentDeltaEvent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ContentDeltaEvent.md): An event that contains incremental output from a command execution.
- [ContentStartEvent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ContentStartEvent.md): An event that signals the start of content streaming from a command execution.
- [ContentStopEvent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ContentStopEvent.md): An event that signals the completion of a command execution.
- [Context](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Context.md): The contextual information associated with an evaluation, including span context details that identify the specific traces and sessions being evaluated within the agent's execution flow.
- [ControlStats](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ControlStats.md): Statistics for the control variant in an A/B test.
- [Conversational](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Conversational.md): Contains conversational content for an event payload.
- [CryptoX402PaymentInput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CryptoX402PaymentInput.md): The input for a crypto X402 payment.
- [CryptoX402PaymentOutput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CryptoX402PaymentOutput.md): The output from a crypto X402 payment.
- [CustomDescriptor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_CustomDescriptor.md): A custom descriptor configuration for a registry record.
- [DataSourceConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_DataSourceConfig.md): Configuration for the data source used in evaluation.
- [Descriptors](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Descriptors.md): Contains the descriptor configuration for a registry record.
- [EmbeddedCryptoWallet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EmbeddedCryptoWallet.md): Embedded crypto wallet instrument details.
- [EvaluationContent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluationContent.md): A content block for ground truth data in evaluation reference inputs.
- [EvaluationExpectedTrajectory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluationExpectedTrajectory.md): The expected tool call trajectory for trajectory-based evaluation.
- [EvaluationInput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluationInput.md): The input data structure containing agent session spans in OpenTelemetry format.
- [EvaluationJobResults](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluationJobResults.md): Aggregated results from a batch evaluation, including session completion counts and evaluator score summaries.
- [EvaluationMetadata](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluationMetadata.md): Metadata for the evaluation, including session-specific ground truth data.
- [EvaluationReferenceInput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluationReferenceInput.md): A reference input containing ground truth data for evaluation, scoped to a specific context level (session or trace) through its span context.
- [EvaluationResultContent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluationResultContent.md): The comprehensive result of an evaluation containing the score, explanation, evaluator metadata, and execution details.
- [EvaluationTarget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluationTarget.md): The specification of which trace or span IDs to evaluate within the provided input data.
- [Evaluator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Evaluator.md): An evaluator to run against sessions during batch evaluation.
- [EvaluatorMetric](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluatorMetric.md): Statistical metrics for a single evaluator comparing control and treatment variants.
- [EvaluatorStatistics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluatorStatistics.md): Aggregated statistics for an evaluator.
- [EvaluatorSummary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EvaluatorSummary.md): Summary statistics for a single evaluator within a batch evaluation.
- [Event](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_Event.md): Contains information about an event in an AgentCore Memory resource.
- [EventMetadataFilterExpression](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_EventMetadataFilterExpression.md): Filter expression for retrieving events based on metadata associated with an event.
- [ExecutionSummaryAffectedSession](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ExecutionSummaryAffectedSession.md): A session associated with an execution summary cluster.
- [ExecutionSummaryCluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ExecutionSummaryCluster.md): A cluster of similar execution patterns identified across sessions.
- [ExecutionSummaryClusteringResultContent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ExecutionSummaryClusteringResultContent.md): The execution summary clustering result containing grouped execution patterns identified across evaluated sessions.
- [ExternalProxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ExternalProxy.md): Configuration for a customer-managed external proxy server.
- [ExtractionJob](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ExtractionJob.md): Represents the metadata of a memory extraction job such as the message identifiers that compose this job.
- [ExtractionJobFilterInput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ExtractionJobFilterInput.md): Filters for querying memory extraction jobs based on various criteria.
- [ExtractionJobMessages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ExtractionJobMessages.md): The list of messages that compose this extraction job.
- [ExtractionJobMetadata](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_ExtractionJobMetadata.md): Metadata information associated with this extraction job.
- [FailureAnalysisResultContent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_FailureAnalysisResultContent.md): The failure analysis clustering result containing categorized failure clusters with root causes and remediation recommendations.
- [FailureCategoryCluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_FailureCategoryCluster.md): A top-level failure category identified by clustering similar failure patterns across sessions.
- [FailureSpanDetail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_FailureSpanDetail.md): Details about a specific span where a failure was detected.
- [FailureSubCategoryCluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_FailureSubCategoryCluster.md): A subcategory of failures within a top-level failure category.
- [FilterInput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_FilterInput.md): Contains filter criteria for listing events.
- [FilterValue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_FilterValue.md): A value used in filter comparisons, supporting different data types.
- [GatewayFilter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GatewayFilter.md): A filter to restrict which gateway target paths are included in the A/B test.
- [GroundTruthSource](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GroundTruthSource.md): Where to pull ground truth from.
- [GroundTruthTurn](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GroundTruthTurn.md): Ground truth data for a single conversation turn.
- [GroundTruthTurnInput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/APIReference/API_GroundTruthTurnInput.md): The input for a ground truth conversation turn.
